model.description: Partial reconstruction of Level-0 definitions and scoped physical, optical, retinal, visual and neural evidence. Levels organize the display; they do not establish a universal emergence order. Formal specifications, computational models, experimental preparations, observations and conditional interpretations have distinct roles. Each scientific claim retains its reviewed sources, selected system, observable, uncertainty and unresolved limitations. Physical records distinguish field and representation definitions from detector data, lattice computations and inferred parameters. Scattering, jets, resonances, decay, form factors and magnetic moments retain their preparation, calibration and response. Nuclear and atomic mass inputs, corrected readouts and dependent combinations preserve external scales, common exposure and covariance limits. Lattice spectra, local source-conditioned field profiles and static-source screening retain their action, ensemble, operator and extrapolation boundaries; pure-gauge criteria, dynamical screening and hadronic interpretations are distinct. Profile shape and fitted width do not identify a vacuum condensate, real-time self-organization or universal stable matter. A fixed-input nuclear lattice calculation is distinct from controlled quark-mass sensitivity, physical binding measurements and a many-body material or astrophysical equation of state. Finite-volume shifts and bound-state assignments retain their state-identification limits. Material and collider charge searches do not establish universal free-color absence. Entanglement, regulated vacuum entropy, Bell tests and teleportation retain their subsystem, measurement and communication assumptions. Electroweak parameters and lepton flavor conventions remain separate from collider rates and species-specific decay evidence. Neutrino oscillations distinguish production/detection coherence, effective packet overlap and unresolved-event averaging. A conditional solar application keeps production and detector weights external; reactor, solar, atmospheric and accelerator findings retain distinct preparations and historical inference models. Quantitative astrophysical/cosmological transport and mass origin lie outside that oscillation scope. A separate linear single-field cosmological model defines conditional primordial curvature power, with restricted conservation and stochastic interpretation. Selected Planck angular statistics constrain a scalar power-law spectrum through declared transfer, foreground and likelihood assumptions; they do not measure an initial quantum state or uniquely prove its origin. Large-scale-structure evidence is outside that CMB application. Optical, retinal and neural studies distinguish measured response from anatomy, intervention and theoretical interpretation. Behavioral success and fitted models do not identify a unique mechanism. Finite checks reproduce only their declared data or mathematical witnesses, not entire experiments. Source discrepancies and unreproduced stages remain explicit. Cross-domain construction, universal parent weights and carrier minima, downward causation and a derivation of quantum theory from Level 0 remain unestablished. Wilsonian transformations, parameter running and physical time remain distinct. Effective operator expansions retain matching and truncation assumptions; Gaussian scaling and selected running fits do not establish universal low-energy laws or condensed-matter critical behavior. Photon gauge states, triggered detector counts and conditional anticorrelation are distinct. Selected radiative observations do not establish empirical mass/charge zeros, persistent identity or static real-photon flux. Neutrino mass/flavor structure separates conditional splitting evidence from absolute masses and unknown mass generation. Closed-sector phase and mass-shift invariances do not establish a unique extension. Gauge sectors are a chosen coupled-model decomposition, not a measured formation event. No whole-graph scientific validation is claimed.
